value.name: Daniel realizes the journal is the missing evidence
value.description: Daniel looks at the journal and understands that what he hoped was still upstairs has already been brought into the room in their mother's handwriting.
evidence: He looked at the journal then for the first time, and Asha watched him understand that whatever he had been hoping was still upstairs in a logbook had already been carried down into this room, in writing, in their mother's hand.

value.name: Asha opens the journal to the final entry
value.description: Asha turns the journal back to the last entry their mother made, aligning it with the date on the codicil.
evidence: Asha drew the journal flat in front of her and turned its pages back, slow and deliberate, until she found the last entry their mother had made
the same date the brass key still pinned to the line of the codicil at her elbow

value.name: Rosa confirms the date match
value.description: Rosa does not need to inspect the page because she already knows the significance of the matching dates.
evidence: Rosa did not lean over to look; she already knew.

value.name: Rosa orders Daniel to read the dates
value.description: Rosa presses a finger on the journal and tells Daniel to read the dates while staring him down.
evidence: Instead she set one finger square on the cloth cover, just at the corner of the open page, and said, "Read the dates," without lifting her eyes from Daniel's face.

value.name: Daniel compares the handwritten and typed dates
value.description: Daniel reads the dates and realizes the mother's handwritten entry and the typed page were created within hours of each other in the same house.
evidence: Daniel looked, because at that point there was nowhere else in the room to put his attention

Asha watched the small movement at his jaw as he matched the day in their mother's handwriting to the day on the typed page and understood that the two documents had been made within hours of each other, in the same house, by a woman who had still been keeping her daily account.

value.name: Daniel falls silent and braces himself
value.description: Daniel says nothing and places his hand on the table for support as the implication sinks in.
evidence: He did not speak; his hand left his cuff and settled, finally, flat on the edge of the table, as if he needed something solid to stand against.

value.name: Asha slides the journal under Daniel's hand
value.description: Asha moves the open journal so the final entry lies directly beneath Daniel's palm, forcing him to confront it physically.
evidence: Asha eased the journal across the table until its open edge slid beneath Daniel's flattened hand, so that the last entry in their mother's thin late ink lay directly under his palm.
